What the collective does

Custom designs

Bring an idea and plan it together. Customers write that the design is customised until it feels right, even with local motifs like the national flower.

Fine line to full sleeves

Dotwork and fine lines, free hand and colour, sleeves and full body pieces, cover-ups and touch-ups.

Walk-ins

Several customers got their tattoo as walk-ins. One came in only to ask and left a few hours later with new art.

Piercing

Tattoos and piercings under one roof, with aftercare explained before you leave.

Why people come back

What customers notice on Google.

The atmosphere

Atmosphere is the word that comes up most in the reviews: professional, easy going and friendly at the same time.

Clean and safe

Customers describe a very clean studio and sterile, safe tools.

A coffee after

More than one review mentions being offered a coffee once the session was done.

In the heart of Limassol

Sinners Tattoo Collective is at Anexartisias 43, behind a black sign with the name in gothic letters. Several artists share the studio, each with a style of their own, and some of them also teach tattoo courses. Reviews come from locals and from visitors, in English and German; one visitor from the US booked and planned her tattoo with the artist over WhatsApp.

What customers say

Two of 78 Google reviews, 5.0 stars on average.
